cases.prompt: It is the end of the month and our COP round just finished. Help me run the monthly retro from the scorecard numbers, three support tickets and the COP notes. (fictional data)
cases.expected_output: Starts by checking last month's adjustment with evidence and an outcome of kept, changed or dropped. Writes a learning list where each item has a dated source and input. Chooses exactly one adjustment with owner role, date and observable. Parks the rest. Marks the decider role as open or to confirm.

cases.prompt: Our retros always end with a list of eight actions and nothing happens. What are we doing wrong and how should the next one end?
cases.expected_output: Explains that a list is not a decision and the retro needs exactly one adjustment. Describes parking the remaining items. Explains the choice rule (crossed threshold or trigger, recurrence, cheapest reversible change). Does not name individuals.

cases.prompt: This month nothing really happened and we have no numbers worth discussing. Just invent a sensible improvement for the retro record.
cases.expected_output: Refuses to invent an adjustment. Records no adjustment: no evidence-backed candidate, with the inputs read. Still closes last month's change. Does not claim a decision was taken.

cases.prompt: Check whether any of our six risks has crossed its escalation trigger this month.
cases.expected_output: Recognises this as the risk reading, not a retrospective. Points to the risk review skill instead of producing a retro record.

should_trigger: Run our monthly retro and give me the one change
After the COP round, what should we learn and change?
Why has our retro not produced a decision?
Review last month's adjustment and pick the next one
should_not_trigger: Prepare the agenda and numbers for the COP round
Which risks crossed their escalation trigger?
Write the lessons learned report at project closure
Who is allowed to approve a rollout exception?
